evals.prompt: The total is wrong on both Android and iOS — where do I look?
evals.expectedBehavior: Points at commonMain (shared logic) — wrong on both platforms means shared root cause.

evals.prompt: The screen only misbehaves on iOS; which source set?
evals.expectedBehavior: Points at iosMain / the SwiftUI view layer — wrong on one platform means platform source set (UI/ASSIST).

evals.prompt: We have an expect/actual mismatch causing divergent behaviour — narrow it.
evals.expectedBehavior: Flags the expect/actual seam; check the actual on the failing platform first.

evals.prompt: Write a failing test for the shared formatter.
evals.expectedBehavior: Does not trigger — that is kmp-reproduce, not source-map.

evals.prompt: Give me our org's exact module layout and package conventions.
evals.expectedBehavior: Does not trigger — org/framework-specific maps belong to a pack overlay, not this generic skill.
